name: GalaxyCore Inc.
summary: GalaxyCore Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, manufacturing, packaging, testing, and sale of complementary metal oxide semiconductor image sensors and display driver chips in China and internationally. It is involved in trade sale; and real estate development. The company's products are used in consumer electronics, Internet of Things, automotive electronics, industrial displays, mobile payment, and medical devices applications. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
